chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a slim Moroccan young man about 19, short black hair, wearing a teal-blue hoodie with a white chest stripe, grey joggers and white sneakers
chars.AUNT: AUNT: a plump Moroccan woman in her fifties wearing a bright orange house djellaba with a brown floral headscarf
chars.COUSIN: COUSIN: a Moroccan young woman about 22 with long dark wavy hair in a low ponytail, wearing a cropped denim jacket over a black turtleneck and a long olive-green skirt, small gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan family living room in Kenitra with sedari couches, seen from the doorway: AUNT holds out a folded banknote to NARRATOR and points firmly outside, giving an errand, NARRATOR looks surprised; head-to-waist framing, faces visible, comic mood

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands at the start of a long sunny Kenitra street at evening, looking far down the road toward a tiny distant corner grocery shop with a green awning, shoulders slumped, comic dismay

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the living room AUNT talks with a sly smile and raised finger, insisting, while NARRATOR protests with open palms, a low table with mint tea glasses between them

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: AUNT counts on her fingers explaining what to buy, NARRATOR rolls his eyes and nods, a plate of msemen on the table, warm lamp light

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan kitchen, AUNT and COUSIN whisper together conspiratorially near the fridge, COUSIN glancing over her shoulder toward the doorway, sneaky expressions

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the apartment front door, COUSIN quickly puts on her shoes with a too-innocent smile saying she will come along, NARRATOR stares at her suspiciously holding the banknote

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: COUSIN and NARRATOR walk side by side on a quiet Kenitra sidewalk with palm trees at dusk, COUSIN biting her lip and glancing at him as if about to say something, NARRATOR looking straight ahead awkwardly

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Wide view of a long empty street with street lamps turning on, COUSIN and NARRATOR walking in awkward silence with space between them, the small shop still far away

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot under a street lamp: COUSIN turns to NARRATOR with a friendly curious face asking him a question, NARRATOR raises his eyebrows, surprised she is suddenly talkative
